purpose: The card token vault processes and stores primary account numbers (PANs) securely, ensuring that payment services work with tokens instead of direct PAN data.

components.name: tokenization-service
components.evidence: tokenization-service, a small stateless service with two operations: tokenize (PAN in, token out) and detokenize (token in, PAN out).

components.name: vault-db
components.evidence: vault-db (PostgreSQL), the datastore that holds encrypted card records and the token mapping.

components.name: Vault and KMS
components.evidence: Vault and KMS, the secret store and key management service from which the service obtains data encryption keys and runtime secrets.

components.name: vault private subnet
components.evidence: The surrounding network layer, which limits who can reach what.

flows.evidence: A payment service sends a PAN. The tokenization-service validates the format, obtains a data encryption key, encrypts the PAN, writes the record and the token mapping to vault-db and returns the token.
The tokenization-service reads and writes encrypted card data in vault-db.
A payment service sends a token and a purpose code. The tokenization-service checks that the caller is allowed to detokenize for that purpose, reads the record, decrypts it and returns the PAN.
Every detokenize call is written to the audit log with the caller identity, the purpose code and the token, never the PAN.
